member.name: T:Replay.Valorant.Events.ValorantEventEnricher
member.summary: Derives gameplay events from native parser events and forwards both to the consumer.
member.remarks: Create one instance per replay. Call Complete only after a successful read.

member.name: M:Replay.Valorant.Events.ValorantEventEnricher.Complete
member.summary: Flushes deferred gameplay events after parsing succeeds. Repeated calls have no effect.
